hook: India have played 300 T20Is and won 200 of them.
lines: Chasing, they've won 71% of the time. Batting first, 64%.
And they've never scored faster: 10.4 runs an over this year, up from 6.4 in 2006.
Rohit Sharma has the most runs, 4,231. Virat Kohli averages the most, 49.3.
The biggest turnaround: a win from a 1% chance, against Bangladesh in 2016.
